text:
Alex Chen: heads-up — after the RBAC cleanup this morning some users in prod-engineering can't SSO. SCIM provisioning also failing with KMS errors when creating new users. seeing 500s in the SCIM worker logs. anyone already looking? :eyes:
Samir Rao (oncall): I'm on it. can you paste the exact error from the SCIM logs?
Alex Chen: here's the snippet from the SCIM service (sanitized):
```
2025-06-12T09:12:03Z scim-worker ERROR user-provisioning id=usr_123 KMSDecryptionError: failed to unwrap key for alias/rdwd-provisioning-key: AccessDenied
stack: at kms.Client.Decrypt(...) at scim.provisioner.CreateUser(...)
```
Jen Li: AccessDenied from KMS usually means either the key policy or the role used by the scim-service lost decrypt permissions. Did we rotate the service-role or the key alias?
Priya Patel: I rolled a couple of RBAC changes earlier to remove a stale svc account, but I only changed org-level roles, not infra IAM. Could be related if the scim service account got its org groups changed.
idp-bot: SAML provider cert rotated 3h ago by automation (rotation-runner). No errors reported by the rotation job.
Samir Rao (oncall): checking IAM for the scim role now. @infra-bot kick off a key policy diff for alias/rdwd-provisioning-key vs previous version?
infra-bot: running key policy diff, ETA ~45s.
Alex Chen: also noticed SAML NameID for a handful of users changed from email to persistent-id after the RBAC change. login logs show mapping not found for those identities. Could be two separate failures but happening same timeframe.
Jen Li: ok two parallel hypotheses: 1) SCIM KMS decrypt denied due to role/alias policy or external account removal; 2) SAML attribute mapping broke because the NameID format changed. start with KMS since it blocks provisioning (500s).
Samir Rao (oncall): infra-bot returned diff: "policy removed: kms:Decrypt for arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/scim-service-role" — looks like that role lost explicit decrypt.
Priya Patel: ah that role is still present but we removed its membership from the 'infra-service-roles' group as part of the RBAC cleanup. We assumed role-only policies would be intact. apparently we had a cross-account policy that referenced the group principal. my bad.
Alex Chen: can we temporarily re-add the role to the group to unblock provisioning?
Jen Li: yes we should do a quick rollback to restore Decrypt, then perform a least-privilege fix after. Samir, want me to make the change or do you?
Samir Rao (oncall): I'll patch the key policy to re-allow the role explicitly. applying now.
Samir Rao (oncall): applied patch. SCIM worker logs show retrying queued provisioning jobs.
Alex Chen: seeing user create succeed for 3/3 retries. SCIM 200s now. :white_check_mark:
Jen Li: check SAML side — NameID mismatch still blocking interactive logins?
Alex Chen: still failing for a subset. error from auth-proxy: "PrincipalNotFound: no mapping for NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent for user@example.com"
Priya Patel: that matches my change earlier — I switched the 'email' attribute mapping to canonicalId for group sync. I didn't realize SAML consumer relied on email NameID.
Jen Li: simple fix: update IDP mapping to map NameID to email for the Exchange connector, or change the SP mapping to accept persistent and look up by external id. which is lower-risk?
Samir Rao (oncall): lower-risk is mapping NameID to email at IDP side for the prod-engineering tenant — can do a tenant-specific override. I'll patch the mapping and restart the SAML proxy.
Samir Rao (oncall): patched IDP mapping for prod-engineering tenant and restarted auth-proxy.
Alex Chen: login successful now for the previously affected user. provisioning and interactive login green.
Jen Li: good. next steps: 1) Priya to add a playbook entry documenting the coupling between group/RBAC edits and KMS key policies; 2) infra to change KMS key policy to reference the role ARN explicitly (avoid group principal); 3) add an automated check in the RBAC change pipeline to diff KMS policies when group membership changes.
Priya Patel: will write the playbook and open a PR with the KMS policy change.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-7829 to change key policy to role ARN and added pipeline job INFRA-7830 for policy diffs on RBAC changes.
Jen Li: also file a short incident writeup, mark sev=3, tag SSO/SCIM/KMS. I'll start the incident doc draft.
Alex Chen: thanks all — quick mitigation worked. tagging for postmortem so we don't regress. :thumbsup:
Samir Rao (oncall): follow-up: will run a scan across all provisioning keys to ensure no other policies reference group principals. ETA EOD.
Jen Li: closing the thread once incident doc is in the drive. link: https://redwood-internal/incident/2025-06-12-sso-scim-kms-7829 (placeholder)
Alex Chen: closing, please ping if anything else pops up.
